question: ______ is the fundamental structural unit of living organisms.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cell.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **smallest and most basic unit **of life is the cell.
 
• Cells make up the **majority **of living things, and it is the processes that cells perform that allow **life to continue**.
 
• Because of this, cells are also referred to as the** fundamental building block **of living things.
 
• The smallest building blocks of all living things are called **cells.**
 
• A cell has the ability to live independently and do all the tasks required of a living thing.
 
• **Nutrition, respiration, excretion, transportation, and reproduction are all carried out by a cell.**
 
• Since they contribute to the structure of the organism, cells are structural units.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cell:**

 
 
• Unicellular organisms are able to I live **independently** and carry out the** fundamental tasks of life**.
 
• Independent living cannot be guaranteed if a cell's structure is incomplete.
 
• As a result, the cell is the **basic structural and functional unit **of all living things.
 
• **Cells **come together to form the body of every organism, much as how bricks come together to form a house.
 
• A tissue is made up of a number of cells that have a certain job to do.
 
• An organ is made up of a** group of tissues**, while an organism is made up of a group of organs.
 
• Because of this, cells are regarded as the fundamental **building blocks** of living things.
 
• Cells are the **building blocks **of all living things.
 
• The cell is where all **biological activities** take place.
 
 
 
• An **organism** is made up of **various organs**.
 
• **Organ system: **
 
 
• **​**A group of organs that cooperate to carry out **one or more functions** is known as an organ system in biology.
 
• Each organ in a** plant or animal body is composed of certain tissues **and serves a specific purpose.
 
 
 
• **Tissue:**
 
 
• **​**Tissue is a **collection of cells **with a common structure and function that work as a **single unit.**
 
• The body's tissues give it form and aid in **energy storage and heat retention**.
 
• Connective tissue, epithelial tissue, muscle tissue, and nervous tissue are the **four different types** of tissues.
 
 
 
• **Organ:**
 
 
• ​An organ **sits between a tissue and an organ system** in the hierarchy of life.
 
• Similar cell types come together to form tissues that perform a **certain purpose**.
 
• An organ is made up of a **variety of tissues that work together** to provide a certain function.
 
• For instance, the intestinal wall is made of both **smooth muscle and epithelial tissue.**
